title: Villa Galini | KEY.co
description_expanded: The open-concept living area is warm and inviting, flowing seamlessly into a fully equipped kitchen and dining space that invites connection. Each bedroom is its own sanctuary, with smart TVs and plush bedding—two featuring king suites, one with a queen, and a fun bunk room perfect for kids. Whether gathering for movie night, enjoying a sunset cruise to the beach, or simply savoring quiet mornings on the patio, Villa Galini delivers a relaxing and memorable escape tailored for families, friends, and unforgettable coastal moments. Villa Galini is a bright and welcoming retreat just moments from the shoreline, designed for effortless beach living and laid-back luxury. Tucked away in a peaceful neighborhood, this four-bedroom haven combines comfort, style, and convenience—complete with an on-site golf cart and beach gear to make each coastal outing a breeze. After sun-soaked days, rinse off in the outdoor shower before settling into the thoughtfully designed interiors, where relaxed elegance meets modern functionality.
